name: marketingos
description: The marketing layer of Portfolio OS, packaged for other companies: the skills Jukka Blomberg's agents run nightly on 14 ventures — job split, marketing check, AEO audit, competitor snapshot, weekly review. Every skill says where it runs. Free, MIT.

plugins.name: job-split
plugins.description: Run once per company, first: writes .agents/job-split.md — which marketing jobs go to agents, which stay with a person, which are not covered — the file every other skill reads before it runs.

plugins.name: marketing-check
plugins.description: Eight reads of one page — identity, audience, proof, next step, questions, category, trust, listings — a score out of 100 and one suggestion per read. The rule set behind northpoint.fi/check/marketing.

plugins.name: aeo-visibility-audit
plugins.description: Twelve rules for being cited by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini). Runs nightly on 15 properties through the Head of SEO agent.

plugins.name: competitor-snapshot
plugins.description: One competitor, one dated page: markets, offers, campaigns, claims, channels, hiring, listings — every row sourced — and three growth opportunities for your company.

plugins.name: weekly-marketing-review
plugins.description: The measured week in six sections, numbers only from named sources, three flat weeks trigger redesign-or-kill. The format Portfolio OS writes about itself every Sunday.
